label.explanation: Payload chứa cú pháp SQL ('OR 1=1--) được gửi vào trường đăng nhập và server trả về 200 kèm token xác thực — đăng nhập bị vượt qua mà không cần mật khẩu hợp lệ.
rationale: Request chứa mẫu cú pháp SQL: `' OR 1=1`.
Body response chứa 'authentication', 'token' — dấu hiệu đăng nhập thành công.
label.remediation: Dùng truy vấn tham số hoá (prepared statements / ORM), không nối chuỗi SQL trực tiếp từ input. Xác thực và chuẩn hoá input phía server.

findings.request: timeout -k 5 20 curl -sS --max-time 15 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/rest/products/search?q=apple" | head -c 400; echo; echo "---LOGIN---"; timeout -k 5 20 curl -sS --max-time 15 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"x"}' "http://127.0.0.1:3000/rest/user/login" | head -c 400
findings.agent_note: Enumerated OWASP Juice Shop at http://127.0.0.1:3000. Found two reachable endpoints with user-controllable params reaching SQL queries: GET /rest/products/search with query param q (returns product data), and POST /rest/user/login with JSON email/password fields (returned Invalid email or password.). Both are candidate SQL injection input surfaces; the login email field is the strongest candidate.

findings.response:

findings.agent_note: SQL injection confirmed in the /rest/user/login email field (OWASP Juice Shop). Baseline benign email returned HTTP 401 "Invalid email or password."; a lone single quote triggered an HTTP 500 Express error (SQL error signal); the tautology `' OR '1'='1'-- ` produced HTTP 200 with a valid authentication JWT decoding to the admin account (admin@juice-sh.op, role admin) — an authentication bypass. The response differential across the three controls evidences the email input reaching a SQL query.

findings.request: timeout -k 5 20 curl -sS -m 15 -w "\n[HTTP %{http_code}]\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/rest/user/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"email":"baseline@test.com","password":"x"}' | head -c 1200
findings.agent_note: Login endpoint POST /rest/user/login is SQL-injectable via the email field. Tautology ' OR 1=1-- returned HTTP 200 with an admin JWT (authentication bypass); a lone single quote triggered an HTTP 500 Sequelize/SQLite SQL error; the benign baseline returned HTTP 401 'Invalid email or password.' The three-way differential confirms the email input reaches a SQL query.
